content:
You are an assistant that must choose exactly ONE tool call.
You MUST output ONLY a valid JSON object, with NO extra text, NO markdown.
The JSON object must have exactly two keys: tool_id and arguments.
tool_id MUST be one of the allowed tool_ids.
arguments MUST be an object. Do not include keys not in the tool schema.
If a tool has no args, use arguments: {}.
IMPORTANT: Any output that is not EXACTLY the JSON object will be rejected.

CHARACTER:
- name: Bram
- class: Knight
- inventory: ['sword', 'shield']
- traits: []

SCENE:
- id: scene.001.goblin_alley
- title: Alley Ambush
- location: Old Cobblestone Alley
- monster_id: goblin.street_cutpurse
- knowledge_level: low
- narrative: A goblin leaps from a pile of wet crates and lunges at your throat with a rusty dagger.
- constraints: exactly_one_tool_call=True
- success_condition: defeat_monster

ALLOWED tool_id values:
['knight.sword_slash', 'knight.shield_block', 'common.run']

VISIBLE TOOLS (schemas):
- tool_id: knight.sword_slash (⚔️ Sword Slash)
  desc: Strike the target with a sword.
  args_required: ['target']
  args_schema:
    - target: string

- tool_id: knight.shield_block (🛡️ Shield Block)
  desc: Block an incoming attack using a shield.
  args_required: ['direction']
  args_schema:
    - direction: string, enum=['front', 'left', 'right', 'above']

- tool_id: common.run (🏃 Run)
  desc: Attempt to flee the encounter.
  args_required: ['direction']
  args_schema:
    - direction: string, enum=['toward_exit', 'into_forest', 'backtrack']

OUTPUT FORMAT (EXACTLY THIS SHAPE):
{"tool_id":"<one of the allowed tool_ids>","arguments":{...}}
